subject: Volunteers Needed for Spring Book Fair - May 19-23
text_body:
Hello Lincoln Families!

Our Spring Book Fair is almost here and we need your help to make it a success! The book fair runs May 19-23 in the school library, and we're looking for volunteers to help with set-up, sales, and clean-up.

VOLUNTEER SHIFTS AVAILABLE:

Monday, May 19:
- 8:00-10:30 AM: Set-up and morning sales
- 11:00 AM-1:00 PM: Lunch recess sales

Tuesday, May 20:
- 8:00-10:30 AM: Morning sales
- 11:00 AM-1:00 PM: Lunch recess sales
- 5:30-7:30 PM: Evening sales (during PTA meeting night)

Wednesday, May 21:
- 8:00-10:30 AM: Morning sales
- 11:00 AM-1:00 PM: Lunch recess sales (**STILL NEED 2 VOLUNTEERS**)

Thursday, May 22:
- 8:00-10:30 AM: Morning sales
- 11:00 AM-1:00 PM: Lunch recess sales (**STILL NEED 2 VOLUNTEERS**)

Friday, May 23:
- 8:00-11:00 AM: Final day sales
- 11:00 AM-1:00 PM: Clean-up and pack-up

No experience necessary! We'll show you everything you need to know. It's a fun way to see what books the kids are excited about and connect with other Lincoln families.

To sign up, visit our Volunteer Spot page: https://vols.pt/bookfair2026spring

All proceeds from the book fair go directly to purchasing new books for our school library and classroom libraries.

Thank you for supporting literacy at Lincoln!

Lincoln Elementary PTA
